about.title: About and how buying works — Hanna Vavilava
about.description: I have sold horses since 2016, and only show jumpers since 2021. Five steps: enquiry, video call, viewing, pre-purchase exam, contract.
about.label: About
about.portraitAlt: Hanna Vavilava on a bay horse in an orange winner's rug, wearing a championship sash, in a show arena
about.bio: I have sold horses since 2016, and since 2021 only show jumpers that I choose and train myself. Between three and six horses stand in the stable at any one time — I ride each of them myself for at least four months before it appears on this site. I speak Polish, English and Russian, and I answer myself, with no intermediary.

steps.title: Enquiry
steps.text: The form on this site or WhatsApp. I reply personally within the hour, {hours}.

steps.title: Video call and the full footage
steps.text: Twenty minutes about your level and your goals, and after the call the complete set of recordings: a round with no cuts, flatwork, the horse in the stable and at the farrier.

steps.title: Viewing
steps.text: In person at the stable near Warsaw, with your trainer if you work with one — or through a trusted representative if travelling is not possible.

steps.title: Pre-purchase exam
steps.text: A vet chosen by the buyer, and the buyer sets the scope of the exam. I share X-rays from the last twelve months in advance.

steps.title: Contract, payment, collection
steps.text: A written contract with the horse's description, the price and its health on the day of sale. The collection date is agreed in writing and discussed directly.

faq.title: Questions — Hanna Vavilava
faq.description: Price negotiation, the pre-purchase exam, buying without travelling to Poland, trial periods and viewing lead times — the six questions I am asked most.
faq.label: Questions · 06
faq.heading: The questions I am asked most.
faq.intro: If something is missing here, just ask — I answer myself.

items.a: Prices are stated exactly and are the prices the horses sell for. I do not raise the asking price only to lower it later. If the pre-purchase exam finds something I did not list on the horse's page, we talk about the price or about calling the sale off.

items.q: Who carries out the pre-purchase exam?
items.a: A vet chosen by the buyer. I do not insist on a clinic or a vet. The buyer pays for the exam, and the horse is available at the stable on the agreed day.

items.q: Can I buy a horse without travelling to Poland?
items.a: Yes, but not on the strength of a video alone. The order is always the same: a video call, the full uncut footage, a pre-purchase exam by a vet of your choice, and a viewing by someone you trust. The buyer makes the decision, not me.

items.q: What happens once I decide to buy?
items.a: A written contract describing the horse, the price and its health on the day of sale, then payment and a date for collection. We arrange the collection directly, not through the site.
No. Instead I offer as many rides as you like during the visit, full uncut recordings and a pre-purchase exam as thorough as you choose.

items.q: How long does it take to arrange a viewing?
items.a: Three to five working days. The horses are in training — I need a day to prepare the horse and book a rider to present it.

privacy.title: Privacy — Hanna Vavilava
privacy.description: How personal data is processed on this site.
privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.turnstile: The enquiry forms are protected from spam by Cloudflare Turnstile. When someone starts filling in a form, Cloudflare processes their IP address and browser data to tell a person from a bot. The basis is legitimate interest: keeping spam off the channel buyers use to reach Hanna (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). An enquiry that fails the check is never stored.
